claim: One click or ?demo=1 opens a populated G-to-C card within the first screen
where: first-screen action, demo entry point, and README
sandbox: fresh browser context at 390x844 and 1440x1000; enter from the landing action and query alias; assert the rendered sample title is inside the viewport

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /demo once, wait for the service worker, go offline, reload the populated demo and open /privacy

claim: Editing, exports, and new share links keep lesson text out of HTTP requests
where: privacy section, privacy page, and README
sandbox: fresh browser context; edit a real card, export SVG, create and open a fragment share link, and assert lesson text is absent from all request URLs and referrers

claim: Demo actions and returned demo license tokens do not change real product storage
where: demo banner, privacy page, demo documentation, and README
sandbox: seed every real product local-storage key; open /demo?license=..., edit, reset, exit, and assert all keys are unchanged with no cross-origin request

claim: The lesson-card preview changes as you type
sandbox: edit the sample title and chord in /demo and assert the rendered SVG text and accessible name both change

claim: The card renders a six-string chord grid, fingering, capo, six tab strings, and a teacher note
sandbox: open /demo and inspect the populated SVG for all six strings, fingering, capo, six tab lines, and sample note

claim: Exports a valid lesson card as SVG or PNG
where: editor actions, first-screen facts, and README
sandbox: use /demo and assert SVG content plus PNG signature and file size

claim: Your card stays in this browser
where: first-screen facts, privacy page, and README
sandbox: fresh browser context; edit the real editor, assert the namespaced local-storage draft, reload, and compare the exact lesson syntax

claim: Clear card removes the saved lesson from this browser
sandbox: fresh browser context; save a real lesson, confirm Clear card, and assert the editor, preview, and draft storage are empty

claim: Ctrl+Enter exports SVG and Alt+1 returns focus to the editor
sandbox: open /demo; invoke both documented shortcuts; assert the SVG download and editor focus

claim: SVG and PNG card exports stay free
where: first-screen facts, paid tier, terms, and README
sandbox: fresh browser context with no stored license; use /demo, download both exports, and assert no cross-origin checkout or license request

claim: There is no song library, playback, account, or tracking
sandbox: fresh browser context; make a demo card, assert no playback or account controls, and assert every request is same-origin

claim: A copied share link restores the exact lesson text
where: editor action, How it works, and README
sandbox: copy the /demo link, open it in the clean context, and compare all syntax

claim: An older ?c= share link is restored and immediately removed from the address
sandbox: open an encoded legacy query link; assert exact restored syntax, migration warning, and a clean address

claim: Validation names the invalid lesson field and blocks export
where: editor status, How it works, and README
sandbox: enter invalid frets and capo in /demo; assert named errors, no malformed SVG, no browser error, and no download

claim: Frets accept x and 0 to 12, fingers accept x and 0 to 4, and capo accepts 0 to 12
sandbox: exercise each lower and upper bound in /demo, then reject the adjacent lower and upper values

claim: The optional worksheet pack exports four cards on one SVG sheet
sandbox: use the sample-only worksheet preview in /demo; assert four card transforms in the SVG

claim: A returned valid license activates the worksheet pack in this browser
sandbox: fresh browser context; intercept the billing verification response for a returned license and assert stored token, stripped URL, and worksheet activation

claim: A pasted valid license activates the worksheet pack in this browser
sandbox: fresh browser context; paste a token, intercept a valid billing response, and assert storage plus worksheet activation

claim: Buying or verifying a license uses Sociobot billing without sending lesson text
sandbox: enter unique lesson text, intercept both checkout and verification, and assert their URLs and bodies omit the lesson

claim: The advertised $9 worksheet pack opens the hosted Dodo checkout through Sociobot
sandbox: request the production billing checkout endpoint without following redirects; assert its 303 redirect targets a Dodo hosted checkout session
